description: Per-TLD bootstrap data, from IANA sources

tld.purpose: Reserved for use in documentation and examples.
tld.remarks:
The .example top-level domain is reserved against usage in the global Domain Name System so it may used tutorials, training, and other forms of documentation. As names under .example do not resolve to real services or conflict with registered domains, it can be used safely to illustrate concepts without generating unintended traffic or raising privacy concerns.

For further information, see [Special-Use Domain Names](https://www.iana.org/go/rfc6761#section-6.5) (RFC 6761) and [Reserved Top Level DNS Names](https://www.iana.org/go/rfc2606) (RFC 2606).
